_doc: The HUD's Z6 windows (src/ui/windows/window_host.gd and the GameWindow kinds; specs in design/ux/). Kept apart from ui_hud.json so the map's alive-layer work and the windows never edit one file (2026-11-23). history_max: the window history length (hud.md Layout Zones Z6, 20). refusal_seconds: how long a refusal note stays (interaction-patterns.md Refusal note). compact_width: below this layout width the windows use their compact layout (1280x720 is compact). panel_share: the host's width as a share of the screen (hud.md Z6, about a third).

widths._doc: Per-kind width shares of the side-panel windows (round-3 mock-ups, user 2026-11-24); the rule for which windows are side panels, full screens or centre windows is design/ux/interaction-patterns.md Window sizes.

codex._doc: The Codex (Thiên Thư) window (src/ui/windows/codex_window.gd; design/gdd/codex-karmic-carryover.md): seen_alpha is faint ink for seen-only entries; known_alpha is full ink for known entries; nav_width is the left 10-book index width.

menu._doc: The game menu (src/ui/windows/game_menu.gd). banner: the painting over the main page (a place-catalogue painting).

illustrated._doc: The illustrated windows (round-3 mock-ups, user 2026-11-24; src/ui/windows/illustrated.gd). element_colours: the linh căn gauge fills; element_icons: a technique card's icon by its first element when it has no painted icon of its own; vital_icons: the vitals tiles; talent_icons: the Thiên phú tiles (absent: no icon).

settings._doc: Player settings (design/ux/game-menu.md; hud.md Tuning Knobs, Player settings): default, and min / max or options. Stored in user://settings.cfg by PlayerSettings, one set for all saves. ui_scale in % (capped per window by UiScale); tooltip_delay, tooltip_lock_delay and tooltip_close_grace in seconds; lock_timer / lock_middle / lock_click: the tooltip lock modes (hud.md Tooltip lock, any of the three); colourblind: off or red_green.

rarity_words._doc: The six rarity ranks' words (design/gdd/item-database.md Formulas A; Open Question 13 closed 2026-11-12); the art bible: the word always shows beside the rarity colour.

inventory._doc: The inventory window (design/ux/inventory.md): kind_order = its sections in order, with each kind's section title.

tie_kinds._doc: The relationships page's tie kinds (design/ux/relationships-page.md; npc-relationships.md Visual/Audio): [glyph placeholder until the dark-tile icons are painted, Vietnamese, English]. Bands: faint 1-33, firm 34-66, deep 67-100 (GDD Visual/Audio, Strength).

rankings._doc: The rankings window (design/ux/rankings.md): top_rows = the top rows always shown; around = rows shown either side of the player; the rest sit in gap rows.

dao_do._doc: The Đạo Đồ view (design/ux/dao-do-view.md), drawn like PoE's passive tree (user 2026-11-24). icons: the framed node icon sheets (tools/asset-pipeline/icons/game_icons_dao_do.py). families: the v5 viewer's stat families for the far-zoom dot colours (tools/design/dao_do_rework/content/report.py FAM; a stat in none is craft). colours: by role (DaoDoCanvas.DEFAULTS when absent). open_scale: px per map unit when the view opens on the player's marks.

saves._doc: Save files (SaveStore). dir: where they live; name_max: the longest save name.

window_buttons._doc: Z2's window buttons in order (hud.md element 5): kind = the window the button opens; key = its default hotkey (rebindable); built = false keeps it disabled with its reason, and hidden in play unless the game runs with --show-unbuilt (weak-point review 2026-11-24); icon = its painted medallion (gen_ui_icons.py win_*). provinces: the province at the map view's centre (V; ProvinceWindow, branch provinces-v2).
